name: Pear Desktop Scaffold Validation
description: Verify that scaffolded Pear Desktop projects install, have valid JS, and the app launches without crashing

measure.name: package-json-valid
measure.command: node -e "import { readFileSync } from 'fs'; const p = JSON.parse(readFileSync('./package.json','utf-8')); if (!p.name || !p.pear || !p.pear.pre || !p.pear.routes || !p.pear.unrouted) throw new Error('missing pear config fields')"

measure.name: pear-deps-present
measure.command: node -e "import { readFileSync } from 'fs'; const p = JSON.parse(readFileSync('./package.json','utf-8')); const d = p.dependencies; if (!d['pear-electron'] || !d['pear-bridge'] || !d['pear-run']) throw new Error('missing pear-electron/pear-bridge/pear-run')"

measure.name: required-files-exist
measure.command: test -f index.html && test -f index.js && test -f worker.js && test -f app/bridge.js && test -f app/index.js
